$comment: SHAPE ONLY. Not a bound receipt and not acceptance. Root fills this after frozen evaluator3 + actual independent Grok review + NEW blind. Do not copy historical source21 Claude ACCEPT here.
title: Evaluator3 application input review receipt

standing.description: Must remain non-accepting until bind-review-receipts.v1.py writes readyForAssembly true.

designVersion.description: Frozen evaluator3 candidate version token, e.g. v22. Not hardcoded v21.

consumerVersion.description: NEW blind consumer version. Historical consumer-b.v8/v9 are not this input.

applicationVersion.description: Fresh application package version. Historical application-review.v1 is rejected history.

vendor.description: Public envelope family of the independent design and blind sessions. User authorized Grok interim; Claude remains a later credits path. Coauthor is neither.

reviewerPublicLabel.description: After envelope decode: 'actual Grok independent reviewer' or 'actual Claude independent reviewer'. Must not say coauthor. Must not be inferred from this preparation session.

root.description: Repository root that holds LIVE docs and retained reviews/. Isolated evaluator-successor.v1 is not automatically this root.

manifestSha256.description: Exact frozen subject digest. Review subjectManifestSha256 must equal this.

publicResponsePath.description: Exact public envelope file. Grok: response.public.json preferred, else receipt-named response.raw.json. Claude: response.json. Do not assume one filename across vendors.

processPath.description: Optional process.json. If standing contains coauthor or no source acceptance, bind refuses.

sessionTranscriptPath.description: Grok: chat_history.jsonl under the actual session dir. Claude: unused; retain walks ~/.claude/projects/{session}.jsonl.

requiredFields.description: advisoryApplicationAccount, contracts. Historical v21 also has actualIndependentClaudeReview as a historical key name; successor must not relabel that historical key. New Grok independent review is bound via design.reviewPath.

rootBlindAssent true, fullRead true, actualSessionId equal to decoded blind public sessionId, parentSubjectSha256, review path+sha256, unresolvedRootMustIssues/unresolvedRootShouldIssues empty lists, newAdvisoryApplicationAccount matching blind newAdvisories/advisories ids. Historical v9 assessment lacks this shape and rootBlindAssent is false; it is not this input.

launch.description: Used only by launch-application-review.successor.v1.py after freeze. Not executed by this preparation.
